subject: gk
question: ‘Wings of Fire’ is an autobiography of which of the following personalities?
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​A.P.J Abdul Kalam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A.P.J Abdul Kalam** was the 11th President of India.
 
• He served as the President of India from 2002 to 2007.
 
• '**Wings of Fire**' is the autobiography of A.P.J Abdul Kalam.
 
• He is the **first scientist to become the President of India.**
 
• He is the first President of India to visit the **Siachen glacier.**
 
• He is the first President to vote in the Assembly election.
 
• The concept of the **PURA**(Providing Urban Amenities to Rural Areas) scheme was given by A.P.J Abdul Kalam.
 
• **Billion beats** e-newspaper was started by A.P.J Abdul Kalam.
 
• He was honored with the **Bharat Ratna** award in 1997.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Notable works of A.P.J Abdul Kalam are:
 
 
• India 2020.
 
• Ignited Minds.
 
• Indomitable Spirit.
 
• Advantage India: From Challenge to Opportunity.
 
 
 
• Playing It My Way is the autobiography of **Sachin Tendulkar.**
 
• My Country My Life is the autobiography of** L. K. Advani.**
 
• One Life Is Not Enough is the autobiography of **K. Natwar Singh,**
